scope: Any valid M4 trace upper bound (even the exact trace), with a Rayleigh-only numerator from the saved M8 two-vector span; initial time-first purification and canonical [8,16] window.
consequence: On beta<=12, transported P=a^2*b<17/25. The ideal first-window purity is (sqrt(2P-1)+(2P-1))/2<=12/25 when P>1/2, otherwise its domain fails. On beta>=12, z<1/2 implies b<1/2 and P<1/2. Thus the fixed recipe cannot certify its first [8,16] window at any beta. This limits recipe outputs, not physical ratios.
